title: The Share Card's metadata strip is clipped: it renders 'M51  Integration 00:35:00  Frames 7  Fil…' and the filter is cut off the right edge
evidence_file_line: packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/services/share_card_renderer.dart:507 — `final fitted = fitCaption(font, segments, bitmap.width);` inside _drawBottomBar; the width-fitting itself is fitCaption at share_card_renderer.dart:326-358, with _ellipsize at :367-382 and _wrapSegments at :387-412
summary: The truncating code the verifier identified (_drawBottomBar in share_card_renderer.dart) no longer truncates in the current working tree. An earlier wave replaced the single-row, width-blind layout with a real fit pass: _drawBottomBar now calls fitCaption(font, segments, bitmap.width), which walks a font ladder (arial48/24/14, never larger than the height-derived choice), greedy-wraps whole 'LABEL value' segments into at most 3 rows that each measure <= cardWidth - 2*pad, and — when even the smallest font cannot fit a segment (a very long target name) — ellipsizes it with ASCII '...' rather than letting img.drawString slice it at the card edge. The old `if (x >= bitmap.width - pad) break;` bail-out and the fixed `barHeight = lineHeight + pad*2` are gone; the bar height is now derived from the wrapped row count. I rendered the exact reported artefact (title 'M51', stats Integration 00:35:00 / Frames 7 / Filter L, 512x512, ShareCardLayout.bottomBar as stack_result_screen.dart:852 builds it) through the production entry point renderPngFromRgba and read the PNG: row 1 is 'M51   Integration  00:35:00   Frames  7', row 2 is 'Filter  L', nothing runs off the right edge and nothing is dropped. I changed no code.
test: packages/skotiq_core/test/services/share_card_renderer_test.dart — group 'bottom-bar caption fits the card width' (3 tests, added by the same earlier wave). Two of them go through the production wiring (renderPngFromRgba -> _composite -> _drawStatPanel -> _drawBottomBar) and scan the rendered pixels in the right-hand padding of every caption row, asserting peak luminance < 120; the third asserts fitCaption loses and reorders nothing. Full file: 28/28 pass (flutter test test/services/share_card_renderer_test.dart in packages/skotiq_core). dart analyze clean on lib/src/services/share_card_renderer.dart + its test.
revert_check: Reverted the production wiring at packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/services/share_card_renderer.dart:507, replacing `final fitted = fitCaption(font, segments, bitmap.width);` with the pre-fix behaviour `final fitted = (font: font, rows: [segments]);` (one row, height-derived font, no width measurement). Result: 2 failures — 'no glyph is drawn in the right-hand padding of a 512px card' and 'a title too wide for the smallest font is ellipsized, not sliced by the card edge', both Expected: a value less than <120> / Actual: <255>, i.e. full-brightness glyphs painted across the right padding. Restored the line; 28/28 pass again and `git diff --stat` on the file is byte-identical to before (183 insertions, 59 deletions).
caveats: Two residuals, neither of them the reported defect and neither reachable in shipping code. (1) _drawCornerCard (share_card_renderer.dart:573-654) still has the original width-blind flaw — it clamps the card rect to the bitmap but hands each line to img.drawString unmeasured, so an over-wide line would be sliced by the right edge. ShareCardLayout.cornerCard has NO production caller: the only two ShareCardSpec constructions in the tree are stack_result_screen.dart:853 (default bottomBar) and live_stacking_broadcast_service.dart:494 (explicit bottomBar); ShareCardSpec has no fromJson and no headless/remote construction path, and no UI exposes a layout picker. Left as-is rather than widening the blast radius of an already-correct verdict — flag it if the corner layout is ever wired up. (2) drawWatermark (:666) draws bottom-left at the same y-band the bar now occupies, so a watermark would overlap the last caption row; this pre-dates the fix (it overlapped the single-row bar too) and the share-card path never sets a watermark (stack_result_screen.dart:853 omits it), while the broadcast path that does set one passes no title and no stats, so its stat panel returns early at :444 and only the watermark is drawn.
